info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/flux-2-flex/edit
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/flux-2-flex/edit queue.

image_urls.title: Image URLs
image_urls.description: List of URLs of input images for editing

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt to generate an image from.
examples: Change colors of the vase. In a cozy living room setting, visualize a gradient vase placed on a table, flowing from rich #6a0dad to soft #ff69b4. Add an artistic carving text with a big font on vase says "FLEX" in the middle.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

image_size.title: Image Size
image_size.description: The size of the generated image. If `auto`, the size will be determined by the model.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Whether to enable the safety checker. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

num_inference_steps.title: Number of Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

safety_tolerance.title: Safety Tolerance
safety_tolerance.description: The safety tolerance level for the generated image. 1 being the most strict and 5 being the most permissive.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed to use for the generation.

guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.description: The guidance scale to use for the generation.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed used for the generation.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the generated image.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the generated image.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
